title: Unit Event — Rekindle the Flame

meta.Outline: Having surpassed RAD WEEKEND, Vivid BAD SQUAD's next goal is to stand on top of the world. As each member strives to better themselves, something seems to be eating at Akito...

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line:
Whoa!
This place has been constantly packed ever since it reopened!

rows.Speaker: Regular B
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Even though a lot of time has passed since that event, it's incredibly busy!

rows.Speaker: Regular B
rows.Line: To be fair, this is where it all started for those kids, so tons of people flock here now. When it comes to RAD BLAST, this is like a place of pilgrimage.

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line: Not to mention that one of those legendary members works here.
Oh, are you guys talking about me?
se_walk_men_004_1

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Here's your usual blend!
I made it extra strong!

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line:
Oh, that smells nice.
Your barista skills have been getting better and better.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Well, I need to be good since Ken left me in charge. I'm not about to drag this place's name through the mud!

rows.Speaker: Regular B
rows.Line:
He really left you in charge...
I don't think any of us expected you to be named interim manager.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Haha. I'm just the manager in name only!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Other people are handling all the accounting and inventory. If anything, I'm more like a part-time worker.

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line:
Still, you should be proud.
In a way, you're Ken's chosen one!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Yeah, I was also pretty surprised when he asked me to take over.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: When I told him that I was looking for a line of work that would let me keep singing, he said, “Why don't you work here?”

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: What he said then made me really happy...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: He told me, “I want to keep this place open for anyone who wants to follow in you guys' footsteps,” and said I was the perfect person to trust with it.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: After hearing that, I had to accept his offer. Unfortunately, I can't serve any alcohol and stuff yet, so I can't operate during the same hours that Ken did...

rows.Speaker: Regular B
rows.Line: I see... Ken said all that?

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line: When we heard the news that Ken would be teaming back up with Taiga, we really thought he'd be packing up shop for good...

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line: Which is why we're so happy that we get to have coffee here again.

rows.Speaker: Regular B
rows.Line: Yeah, so keep up the good work, interim manager!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I will!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Hey, you guys!
I've got a free table over here!

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Locals
rows.Line: Wait, aren't they...?!

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Locals
rows.Line: Azusawa and Aoyagi from Vivid BAD SQUAD, right...?! Now I'm really glad we decided to wait here...!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Your usual blend and cafe au lait, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you.
You seem very busy again today...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah, because of my delicious coffee!
se_run_women_004_1
se_run_women_004_2

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Locals
rows.Line: E-Excuse me!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Locals
rows.Line: Y-You're Azusawa and Aoyagi...from Vivid BAD SQUAD, right...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, yes... That's us...

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Locals
rows.Line: We're sorry about the sudden intrusion, but... W-We decided to learn to sing after seeing RAD BLAST...

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Locals
rows.Line: Would it be alright if we shook hands?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, if you really want to...!

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Locals
rows.Line: Th-Thank you so much...!

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Locals
rows.Line:
We're still really terrible...
But we're going to do our best as a team in order to become amazing singers like you guys...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's such a great thing to hear!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My friends are the reason I've been able to keep singing, so I really understand your desire to do your best for your team.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So... I hope I get to hear you all sing in the future. In the meantime, let's all keep doing our best!

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Locals
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
You've gotta be kidding me!
Why didn't they talk to me like that?!

rows.Speaker: Regular B
rows.Line: Haha. Looks like your coffee wasn't what they were after!

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line: Still, they've really started to have that dignified air that says “celebrity”. You gotta work harder on your aura too!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Grr! Just wait, you guys!
My videos are gonna start getting more views than theirs and...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Wait, Toya...
That reminds me of the new song you posted yesterday! It was really good!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Ah, I'm glad to hear that you liked it.
The new sounds I tried using may've worked well.

rows.Speaker: Regular B
rows.Line:
I also gave it a listen!
It's my favorite out of the ones you've posted recently!

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line: More and more Vivid BAD SQUAD songs keep clearing a million views, and you've been posting one new track after another. You're really on fire!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
But we still have a lot of work left to do, so we can't rest on our laurels just yet.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because our goal is to stand on top of the world.

rows.Speaker: Regular B
rows.Line:
The world, huh...?
It's a big dream, but it doesn't feel impossible when you talk about it, right?!

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line:
Haha! Yeah!
Speaking of which, what are the other two up to right now? What are they doing to take on the world?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They're doing what they can as we speak. Actually, it's been quite a challenge for them...
English Class

rows.Speaker: English Teacher
rows.Line:
Alright, let's begin today's lesson by greeting one another!
How are you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
...
I'm good...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Uh... Pretty good!

rows.Speaker: English Teacher
rows.Line: Okay, you're both able to provide smooth responses, let's try going a little further!

rows.Speaker: English Teacher
rows.Line: What did you do on your day off?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: W-Wait, I caught the first part... But what did he say at the end?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: On your something...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: W-Would you mind repeating that?!

rows.Speaker: English Teacher
rows.Line:
Okay.
What did you do on your day off?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wh-What?
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: English Teacher
rows.Line:
Okay, that's it for today's lesson!
Please make sure to finish the assignments I've given you by next time.

rows.Speaker: Akito & An
rows.Line: Thank you very much...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
My brain feels so full...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Same...
I feel like I just worked out a muscle I'd never used before...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I can pronounce everything perfectly while singing, but when it comes to an actual conversation...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, who cares about language as long as the person you're talking to understands how you feel?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I get what you mean...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you saw how the others did in their class. If we don't get up to at least their level, then we aren't gonna stand a chance abroad...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ugh... Yeah, true...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You're right...!
We have to figure out a way if we're really gonna stand on top of the world...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's do our best, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...!
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I honestly didn't think that you guys would still be taking those English lessons. I was so sure that you'd bail after going a couple times!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why would we do that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Our goal is to stand on top of the world, so we need to start thinking about performing overseas. If we don't deal with this now, then we'll end up paying for it down the road.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Performing overseas, huh...?
I really can't see myself doing that...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: But do you guys know what you're all gonna do in the immediate future?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No specifics yet...
But we have a rough idea.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ideally, we wanna get noticed by a big label that's based overseas! Like what happened to Uncle Taiga and his team!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Some recent artists have been able to get their break by posting videos online, but that would involve quite a bit of luck. We need to somehow increase our odds of getting noticed.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But, we aren't really in a position to get noticed yet.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We still don't have the fame or skills to call ourselves a world-class team yet. For now, we're doing what we can to expand our foothold over here.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Oh, okay!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Wait, is that why the most recent songs you guys uploaded have English subtitles and descriptions...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, we felt that the best way for us to get people around the world to notice us is to post songs online...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But we realized that most people wouldn't understand what we were singing if we just uploaded everything as is. That's why we decided to start translating the lyrics and such.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Once we feel that we've established a firm foothold, we plan on participating in some events overseas. We actually have one in mind already.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Cool...!
It sounds like you've got all your bases covered!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, we weren't kidding when we said that we're gonna stand on top of the world!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Right!
It's a big goal, but we plan on working towards it bit by bit...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, everyone, let's all keep doing our best!

rows.Speaker: Akito, Toya & An
rows.Line:
Yes!
Yeah!
A few days later - Early morning
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, I think we're all warmed up now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I feel ready.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Then, let's get started.
Today... We'll keep practicing what we were doing the other day.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, I really liked that!
It's really fun and a good source of motivation.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Then, as for teams—

<Hey!
Have you guys started practicing already?!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Rin and Len.
With Miku and Luka in tow...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Morning, you guys!
We're here to watch you practice!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Watch us practice?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <You've been practicing in a variety of different ways lately, which has been really fun to watch. So, we decided to come over again!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Fun...?
Well, I guess it is good to have people watching.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. I'm glad you guys came!
It's hard not to feel more motivated with an audience watching!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Hehe! Thanks!
So, what are you guys gonna do today?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: More two-on-two battles like we did the other day, but with different teams.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yes!
I love how a song feels so different depending on who sings it with who!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Anyway, if we continue based on last time...
Kohane, you and I are gonna be on the same team today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay!
Let's do our best, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Feel free to let us know if anything catches your attention, Miku, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Okay, we will.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Then, let's begin.
You guys can start us off.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright... Toya, let's kick their butts!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Whoa...!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Those two are off to a great start!
They're harmonizing so well♪>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Yes, they're achieving a nice balance.
An brings energy, while Toya provides stability... They're drawing out the best in each other.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(They sound good...
And they're in perfect sync.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's go, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay.
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Phew... Okay, let's take a break here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, sounds good!
We've all had a chance to sing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I really do like this way of practicing since it's both fun and rewarding.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I agree.
Not only do you have to adjust your performance to your teammate, but it also allows you to bring out the best in one another.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And battling like this creates the kind of tension you'd feel in a real event.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ken helped us practice leading up to RAD BLAST, but that isn't gonna be possible now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We have to keep coming up with the best ways for us to practice and improve.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. I sort of feel like singing now after watching all of you practice.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <More to the point, the next time you guys are in SEKAI, you should battle against us!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds fun.
But we're not gonna go easy on you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh? That also applies to you guys!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
...?
Sorry, that's mine.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They're making some final confirmation about tomorrow's event. I'll send this over to you guys a little later.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, that's right. You have that event tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Wait, really?!
It's been quite a while since you all last entered into an event.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes, it has.
And we haven't done any since RAD BLAST...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We've mostly been spending our time on English lessons, uploading videos with translated lyrics and practicing on our own.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, we haven't performed in front of an audience in so long! I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, me neither... But we'll also need to stay focused.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Especially since we've been asked to perform as special guests.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Wait, guests?!
Does that mean you guys were invited?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes. Not only that, they're apparently performing at one of the live houses where they trained. One that attracts a lot of high-level talent.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Really?! And you guys have been invited as special guests?! That's awesome!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We were also surprised when they reached out to us, but they apparently decided to invite us after hearing about RAD BLAST.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which is all the more reason why we'll need to put on a solid performance.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Right!
Let's do our best to make sure we don't disappoint!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Go knock their socks off, you guys!
We'll all be rooting for you.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, we will!
They won't know what hit them!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Huh...?
What's wrong, Akito? Is something bothering you?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Nothing.
I was just thinking about how to reply to this message.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, the crowd and other performers are apparently really looking forward to seeing us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, let's make sure our set list and performance live up to the hype.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, okay!
The next day
Live House

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Whoa... So this is Vivid BAD SQUAD...!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: It's no surprise they surpassed that legendary night...!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Yeah!
They're on a completely different level now compared to the last time I saw them here!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Alright, we've been solid from the start!
And the crowd's responding really well to us!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(But we can't let our guard down.
We need to maintain this momentum!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Right!
Let's keep raising the temperature!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Yeah...
Higher...!)
After the performance
Backstage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Great event, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
Hey, thanks for coming!
You guys were awesome!

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
Yeah, I actually did a double-take!
Then again, you guys did put on a pretty insane event!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I'm just glad that we didn't disappoint anyone.

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: Haha. You guys all seem so calm and composed.

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: Yeah. Remember the first time you performed here? You guys were all nervous wrecks.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: C'mon now, we weren't that nervous!

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: Anyway, jokes aside, you guys really have improved a ton since then.

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
Yeah.
We're gonna need to do our best to keep up.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Our performance today wasn't bad.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The crowd got into it, and the other performers said they liked what they saw.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But—)

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: Still, today's event was off the hook!

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: Things haven't been this fun since those two performed here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
Yeah, definitely.
Actually, it would've been great to see them battle against Vivid BAD SQUAD! Imagine that as the main event!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Those two...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Who are you guys talking about?

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: Oh, you guys haven't heard about them yet.

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: So, the other day, these mysterious twin brothers showed up out of nowhere.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Twin brothers?

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
Yeah.
They looked like foreigners. None of us recognized them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Mysterious twin brothers that came from abroad...? You seem to know a lot about these guys.

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
Haha. Yeah.
At first, none of us thought that they'd be any good.

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: But they totally floored us when they started singing!

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: Actually, I feel like they were as good as you guys were at RAD BLAST!

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, I heard that those two performed at a few other places.

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: Really? Where?

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
Uhh... An event at Rodin.
My friend said they blew the roof off the place there too, and won hands down.

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
I heard that they were at notte!
The owner tried to go talk to them, but they just seemed to vanish from the green room.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: Hm? What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Rodin, notte and now here.
Those are...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They're all places we performed at while training, aren't they?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right.
We've been to all of those places.

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: Wow, you guys have performed at some really top-notch venues...

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
Still, what a weird coincidence.
Those two have been performing at all the places you guys did.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: Unless it's not a coincidence...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: Those twins might be two of those people that you guys' event lit a fire inside of.

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: They might be following in your footsteps.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
Hehe. Now I'm getting excited!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, if they're really as good as you guys say they are, then I'd be great to hear them sing! I wish they'd come visit Vivid Street sometime...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What are the odds of that happening?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If they really were inspired by RAD BLAST to become singers like us, then I couldn't be happier.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because that means we were able to light a fire inside of them. Just as RAD WEEKEND did with us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Fire, huh...?)
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That event was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I also really enjoyed it since we hadn't performed in front of an audience in so long.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Exactly!
What if we started working more events into our practice schedule?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I get why you're excited...
But have you done your English homework due tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh?! No, I forgot...!
I need to do it when I get home...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We don't have practice today, so please make sure that you do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ugh... I will...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, let's call it a day here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, see you all tomorrow!
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: By the way, I already finished my homework...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You have?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I made sure to get an early start on them since I knew we'd be performing in an event today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Your foresight is admirable.
I couldn't be prouder as your partner.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Proud?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Do you think you'll be back on your feet soon...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
...
You noticed, then?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
It's subtle, but it's affecting your singing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Okay.
Yeah, that's the thing...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ever since RAD BLAST, I've been having trouble singing with the same power.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm missing that something I had a hold of that time...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If it's showing in my singing, then that means the other two must also know.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I suspect that's the case.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But the fact that they haven't said anything about it means...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I need to get back in the saddle as fast as I can.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Don't look so concerned.
I'm not gonna go off and do anything crazy.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, in the meantime, we'll be waiting.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks.
Akito's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's subtle, but it's affecting your singing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It’s affecting my singing...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I still want to stand on top of the world with them, and I'm doing everything I can to make that happen.)

rows.Speaker: Akito

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So, umm... H-How should we reply?
We'll need to ask our parents, and I doubt we'll be allowed to go by ourselves—

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm going.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This is the USA we're talking about. I'm going.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Y-You serious?!
We're talking about the other side of the world!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know.
But I...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I wanna see the world.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: The world...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's right.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The guy I heard sing today was incredible...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: His technical skills and raw talent were both on another level...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And most of all, he brought a ton of energy.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You guys have all probably noticed how I've lost some of my passion ever since RAD BLAST...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Surpassing RAD WEEKEND...
A part of me became convinced that I'd ever feel as motivated about anything else. I'm so disappointed in myself...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But that's—

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's fine. It's the truth.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But hearing that guy sing made me realize the world really is a big place. I'm sure there are more people like him out there...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And I wanna meet them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Once I start seeing more of this gigantic world, I might find something that makes me feel as driven as I did about surpassing RAD WEEKEND... No, even more than that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Which is why I wanna see the world.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
The world is a big place.
I'm sure that there are plenty of things left to discover and sights we're yet to see.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Then, let's go to Uncle Taiga's event and see the world!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna go too!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Let's go, Akito.
To see a big, brand-new world. The four of us. Together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I still have no idea what the future has in store for us...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Going to the US might not actually change anything.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But still...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'm gonna keep moving forward. As far as I can.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Because the thing that rekindles the flame inside of me might be out there...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'll find it. Even if it means traveling to the ends of the earth!)
